**Finding submitted: Compliant** — no redline, no comment.

Nothing substantive required repair, so this resubmission tightens the rationale while holding the same conclusion, which the verifier's own commentary endorsed on every substantive point:

- **No covenant binds us.** Literal and regex searches across the full document ("solicit", "solicitation", "no-hire", "poach", "employ", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "personnel", "staff", "leave the employ") surface only § 7 (Unsolicited Commercial E-Mail), incidental "employees" references in the § 12 indemnities, and the quoted § 8(c) access-restriction covenant.
- **Both candidate locations read in full** — § 8 (Client covenants) and § 10 (Confidentiality) — confirming the absence rather than inferring it.
- **§ 8(d) is not a hiring restraint.** Its cross-reference to the separate Non-Competition Agreement is scoped to limitations on TrueLink's Credit Data licence.

On the persistent "general-solicitation carve-out: failed" check: I have not chased it, because the only way to make it pass would be to draft a non-solicit into the Agreement and then carve it back — creating a restriction on our own hiring where none exists today. That would be a clear loss for us. The check is unsatisfiable by design when the clause is absent, and absence is the playbook's preferred outcome.

One item genuinely outside my reach: the standalone Non-Competition Agreement referenced in § 8(d) is not in this document set, so a non-solicit or no-hire living there would not be captured here and should be diligenced separately against this rule.
